title: Hummingbird Heart Rate
hook: Your heart beats like a hummingbird's?
script: Your heart beats like a hummingbird's? What if your heart beat over 1,200 times per minute? You'd have to eat almost constantly just to survive, which is exactly what a hummingbird does. A hummingbird's heart beats incredibly fast, but that's not all - its unique physiology allows it to fly in ways other birds can't. But that's not even the strange part. A hummingbird's heart can beat over 1,200 times per minute, and they are the only birds that can fly backwards. Its wings beat up to 80 times a second, letting it hover in place. To put that in perspective, if your heart beat that fast, you could fit over 20 heartbeats in a single second. Your heart beats like a hummingbird's?
